journal_lines: The web was thick as rope. The eggs were not all hatched. Destroyed what was there. Took time.
Nest in the dark corner of the cave. Cleared it. String everywhere.
Spider colony under a fallen log. Dealt with it. Still picking silk out of the fur.
A whole chamber of them. The young ones had not learned what wolves were yet. They learn.
Silk thick enough to walk on, almost. Walked through it instead.
Egg sacs in clusters along the ceiling. Worked carefully. The work was unpleasant.
Old web hung with the husks of things older than the spiders. Old hunting grounds.
Came home with silk in the fur for three days. Could not shake it. Did not need to.
